runs.text: Called a colonizer? Here's your answer, in seven words. Under your post, a comment: Jews are colonizers. Go back to Europe. Jews didn't colonize Israel. They came home. About three thousand two hundred years ago, an Egyptian pharaoh carved the name Israel in stone. About two thousand eight hundred years ago, another stone, found in northern Israel, named the House of David. Palestinians have deep roots here too. Both can be true. Save this. Not colonizers. Home. Which sentence do you need most? Tell me in the comments. So when they call you a colonizer, you have seven words.
